description:
Position: Product Manager

Location: Gurgaon

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience Required: 4+ years

**Product Manager**
===================

**Reports To:** CTO / CEO

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Product Manager who can drive product planning, execution, and coordination across teams. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, business acumen, technical understanding, and experience in managing product documentation and Agile product delivery processes. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, and leadership to define and deliver innovative product solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Prepare and manage PRD (Product Requirement Documents), SRS (Software Requirement Specifications), BRD, and other product documentation.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements from stakeholders.
* Conduct market analysis, competitor analysis, and product feasibility studies.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, Design, and Business teams for successful product delivery.
* Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with development teams throughout the SDLC lifecycle.
* Manage Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Utilize Jira for project tracking, sprint management, and requirement management.
* Collaborate with UI/UX teams and review wireframes, workflows, and prototypes using Figma.
* Monitor project timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, MIS, and presentations using Excel and other reporting tools.
* Support recruitment analysis, resource planning, and team coordination activities.
* Ensure timely delivery of product features aligned with business goals and customer needs.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of PRD, SRS, BRD, and product documentation practices.
* Hands-on experience with SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Working knowledge of Jira and Agile project management tools.
* Strong understanding of technology concepts, software development processes, APIs, and system integrations.
* Experience in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and market research.
* Proficiency in Figma for reviewing product flows, wireframes, and design concepts.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, reporting, and data analysis.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Professional and presentable personality with strong stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* MBA in Management or related field from a recognized institution.
* Experience working in a product-based, SaaS, logistics, fintech, or technology-driven organization.
* Exposure to Product Lifecycle Management and Product Strategy frameworks.
* Ability to manage cross-functional teams and business stakeholders effectively.

**Education**
-------------

MBA in Management or equivalent qualification from a recognized university.

title: Product Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering priorities.
* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and learning behavior.
* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.
* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.
* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.
* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.
* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and post-launch monitoring.
* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.
* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.
* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).
* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.
* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning them into product decisions.
* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.
* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.
* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.
* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.
* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.
* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding platform-specific nuances.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.
* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.
* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).
* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on student performance.
* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led growth.
* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or personalization/recommendations.
* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage environments.
* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.
* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.
* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.
* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.
* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.
* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.

Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.

Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.

Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.

The Playbook

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

Every MetaGO journey kicks off with a massive 35+ biomarker deep dive. From there, we bring in the heavy hitters—endocrinologists, cardiologists, and internal medicine experts—to craft a highly personalized roadmap.

Throw in GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the MetaGO app. With absolute legends like Dr. Kaushal Patel leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.

The Growth & Product Team

Where the GO of MetaGO happens!

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

Here’s What You’ll Be Driving

* The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.

* Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

* The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.

* The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.

* The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For

* Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.

* Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.

* Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.

* Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.

* Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.

* Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.

* Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.

* Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.

* Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)

Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)

We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.

If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.

Let’s build something epic together.

title: Product Manager
description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
* Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
* Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

**﻿Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

**Unlimited Sick Days**

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

**Medical Coverage**

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

**Co-Working Space**

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

**Fun Stuff**

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

title: Product Manager, Doctor Experience
description:
**About the Company**

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

**Role Summary**

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
* Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.
* Bring member data such as blood diagnostics, CGM readings, symptoms and progress into a clean, usable view that supports faster clinical decisions.
* Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
* Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
* Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
* Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
* Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
* Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

**Requirements (Must-Haves)**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
* Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.
* Experience gathering insight directly from doctors and clinical teams and turning it into shipped product.
* Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
* Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
* Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
* Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
* Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
* Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
* Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

  
**Benefits**  
Why Join Elevate Now

* Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
* Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

**Job Description**

Product Manager - Job Description and Responsibilities

Job Description

Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.

The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. This role will identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities, guide technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. They have experience building and scaling AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. They will contribute to shaping the future of Client Services platforms and solutions, ensuring exceptional client and employee experiences, operational efficiency, responsible AI outcomes, resilient operations, and seamless integration with Visa systems.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for high-impact digital, AI, and automation products across a defined product area or process domain within Client Services, including discovery, user research, business-case development, requirements definition, prioritization, responsible AI and risk controls, experimentation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across business, product, technology, operations, design, data science, risk, legal, compliance, and regional teams; influence stakeholders and resolve trade-offs to maintain delivery momentum.
* Develop fluency in the payments ecosystem and Client Services capabilities, workflows, systems, data, controls, and operational dependencies to inform product strategy and execution across multiple process areas.
* Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs; monitor adoption, user experience, operational performance, model quality, risk, and value realization; and use data and feedback to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
* Apply rigorous critical thinking and systems thinking to ambiguous, complex, and multi-dependency Client Services challenges: frame problems, test assumptions, synthesize qualitative and quantitative evidence, evaluate alternatives and risks, make sound product decisions, and clearly articulate the rationale and expected business impact.
* Lead the development of AI-enabled products in partnership with engineering and data science, including use-case selection, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Shape and deliver incident-management platform capabilities and workflow solutions that improve detection, intake, triage, escalation, collaboration, resolution, communications, reporting, and post-incident learning across Client Services.

* A strong bias toward action: able to frame a problem, form a hypothesis, prototype, test, learn and improve within days—not months.

What success looks like

description:
About the Role

Elevate Now is looking for a Growth Product Manager to own the acquisition and activation funnel for our digital health and pharmacy offerings. You will drive efficient, scalable user growth through data-driven experimentation, channel strategy, and conversion optimization across the journey from first touch to repeat purchase and monetization.

In e-pharmacy, growth depends on trust, compliance, and repeat behavior, not just clicks. We want someone who understands how patients discover medicines, upload prescriptions, reorder chronic therapies, and decide where to buy, and who can turn that understanding into measurable funnel gains.

 **Requirements**  
  
What You Will Do

* Own acquisition and activation metrics. Analyze conversion, CLV, repeat order rate, and churn to prioritize high-ROI growth bets.
* Design and run A/B tests across landing pages, app and web onboarding, prescription upload, cart and checkout, pricing and discounting, and subscription or refill flows to improve conversion and reduce friction.
* Optimize the first-order journey: search or catalog browse, Rx upload and validation, pharmacist verification, order placement, and delivery. Identify and fix drop-offs at every step.
* Build and scale growth loops, including SEO and SEM for medicine and condition-led demand, referral programs, refill reminders and chronic-care retention loops, and partnerships with clinics, diagnostics, insurers, and corporate wellness programs.
* Work with performance marketing and CRM teams on channel strategy, CAC efficiency, and lifecycle campaigns (WhatsApp, push, SMS, email).
* Instrument event tracking and build self-serve dashboards covering visit to signup, signup to first order, first to second order, and CAC payback.
* Translate insights into clear PRDs and ship iteratively with design, engineering, data, and pharmacy operations.
* Partner with compliance, pharmacy, and operations teams so growth experiments respect regulatory requirements around prescription medicines, promotions, and data privacy.
* Communicate experiment results, learnings, and next steps clearly to stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

**Must have**

* 2 to 3 years in product or growth, with a track record of experiments that moved core funnel metrics in B2C or B2B2C settings.
* Hands-on experience at an e-pharmacy, online healthcare, or pharmacy marketplace platform (for example in acquisition, onboarding, ordering, or retention).
* Working SQL for cohort analysis, funnel deep-dives, event and query design, and experiment readouts.
* Comfort with GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools, and strong spreadsheet skills.
* Hypothesis-driven thinking, sound prioritization, and strong cross-functional collaboration.
* Familiarity with PLG and growth metrics such as CVR, CAC, LTV/CAC, payback period, and retention.

**Good to have**

* Experience with chronic medication refill, subscription, or adherence journeys.
* Understanding of prescription-driven demand, pharmacist workflows, and OTC versus Rx purchase behavior.
* Experience with SEO for health and pharmacy content, app store optimization, or marketplace and aggregator channels.
* Exposure to healthcare regulations and advertising norms for pharmacy in India.

Success Metrics

* Uplift in conversion at key steps: visit to signup, signup to activation (first Rx upload or first order), and trial or first order to repeat order.
* Lower CAC and shorter CAC payback.
* Improved LTV/CAC.
* Higher 30, 60, and 90-day repeat order rate and refill retention.

Why Join Elevate Now

* Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
* Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

BCG’s Enterprise Services organization is undergoing a bold transformation to become a truly tech-first, AI-powered organization. We aim for structural reinvention and are reimagining how Enterprise Services operates, delivers value, and partners with the business by embedding technology, data, and AI at the core of every service and process.

In our journey to power end-to-end user experiences, our Enterprise Services Digital organization is moving away function-led service delivery to experience-led, platform-enabled capabilities that are scalable, intelligent, and continuously improving. This means:

* Creating seamless user journeys across functions, geographies, and tools
* Designing services as digital products, with clear ownership, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes
* Leveraging AI, automation, and advanced analytics to augment human expertise and unlock productivity
* Building interoperable, API-enabled platforms that reduce fragmentation and technical debt
* Shifting from reactive service provision to proactive, data-driven orchestration

Within this broader transformation, Smart Office is a flagship domain focused on redefining the end-to-end Street-to-Seat and Workplace experience: the seamless journey that begins when an employee or visitor approaches a BCG office and continues through arrival, workspace usage, collaboration, and departure. Our ambition is to create a fully connected, intelligent workplace ecosystem that integrates physical space, digital tools, and operational services into one cohesive experience.

As the Smart Office Global Product Manager, you will play a critical role in defining and delivering this connected workplace vision — ensuring that technology enhances employee productivity, improves operational efficiency, and provides data-driven decision support, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability, security, and scalability. This role will be responsible for helping to define, build and implement the Smart Office Digital Product use cases and roadmap

Among your responsibilities, you will:

* Determine business requirements to shape the BCG Smart Office product journey and Street-to-Seat user experience
* Serve as a Liaison between the Workplace Experience business partners and the Smart Office Product squad to ensure that key business objectives are met
* Working with key senior stakeholders to gather and document business requirements
* Defining the form, content, and capabilities provided in our Smart Office products and solutions
* Identify key changes and impacts to our existing reporting capabilities and products
* Understanding multiple data sources and putting together practical and viable models for the analytics reports being prepared
* Developing comprehensive implementation plans along with delivering the output as defined in the project’s goals and objectives
* Assessing the gaps between the prioritized requirements and the Product capabilities, current and upcoming. Generating solution options and, with the use of an agreed set of design principles, selecting the preferred option to move forward
* Acting as a functional subject matter expert for partnering to troubleshooting Smart Office data issues, redesign processes and develop reports
* Developing training materials and delivering trainings to end-users
* Curating backlog of requested enhancements
* Develop and track technical roadmap for feature enhancements
* Assist with validation of Smart Office data and product builds

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Product Management or Economics. Advanced degree preferred, but not required
* 6-8+ years of experience in Digital Products, Digital Workplace Experience, Data & Space analytics or equivalent field; less experience considered for exceptional performers
* End-to-end product management experience owning roadmap, discovery, delivery, and measurable outcomes for digital or technology-enabled products.
* Smart office / IoT expertise, including connected devices (sensors, access control, HVAC, lighting) and workplace platforms (desk booking, visitor management, hybrid work tools).
* Strong technical fluency, with experience in system integrations, APIs, cloud platforms, data analytics, and collaboration with engineering teams.
* Data-driven decision making, leveraging occupancy, utilization, and energy analytics to inform product improvements and business cases.
* Enterprise stakeholder management, working cross-functionally with IT, Real Estate, Workplace Experience, and executive leadership.

The Senior Product Manager I will help shape and advance reporting capabilities for Nielsen's Ads and Outcomes measurement portfolio. You will own product work from discovery through launch and adoption. You will work with product, engineering, design, and client-facing teams. The ideal candidate is a self-starter. **About Upstox**

Upstox is building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and accessible to everyone. As one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms, Upstox is backed by leading global investors, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global. Our mission is to enable wealth creation for every Indian, serving millions of users ranging from first-time investors to experienced traders. **The Role: Growth Product Manager – F&O**

Futures & Options is one of the most active trading segments at Upstox, and this role sits right where F&O trader behavior meets business outcomes. As Growth Product Manager – F&O, you'll drive business growth and customer engagement across the F&O product, owning initiatives focused on activation, reactivation, revenue and ARPAU improvement.

You'll work closely with the Product Manager and business stakeholders to spot growth opportunities and translate business problems into clear, well-structured requirements. Your core ownership is business requirements, growth opportunities, F&O metrics, funnel optimization and business impact — documented through BRDs rather than PRDs. Your interaction with Design and Engineering will be relatively limited and largely routed through the Product Manager, with Business, Analytics/Data and other cross-functional teams as your day-to-day partners.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**F&O Growth & Business Metrics**

* Drive initiatives that improve key F&O growth metrics — activations, reactivations, engagement and ARPAU
* Identify opportunities across the customer journey that can positively impact revenue and business performance
* Analyze business and customer data to uncover growth opportunities, funnel gaps and areas of improvement
* Work with relevant stakeholders to define success metrics and measure business impact

**Business Requirements & Product Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to identify and prioritize business opportunities
* Translate business problems, customer insights and growth opportunities into detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Clearly articulate the business objective, customer problem, requirements, use cases, expected outcomes and success metrics
* Work with the Product Manager to ensure business requirements translate effectively into product initiatives
* Participate in discussions around feature prioritization and business impact

**New Product & Feature Initiatives**

* Identify and propose new features or enhancements based on customer needs, market opportunities and business objectives
* Develop BRDs for new initiatives and work with the Product Manager through the product development lifecycle
* Support feature launches by defining business objectives, target users, adoption metrics and go-to-market requirements
* Track post-launch performance and recommend improvements to drive adoption and business impact

**Funnel & Growth Optimization**

* Analyze existing F&O customer funnels to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement
* Drive initiatives to improve activation, reactivation, conversion, feature adoption and engagement
* Evaluate existing product features and customer journeys to find opportunities for optimization
* Use data and experimentation insights to recommend changes that improve business outcomes

**F&O Domain Expertise**

* Bring a strong understanding of Futures & Options trading and trader behavior
* Understand key F&O customer journeys, use cases and pain points
* Monitor market and industry trends to identify relevant growth and product opportunities
* Translate F&O business and customer needs into actionable product requirements

**How Success Is Measured**

This role is closely tied to measurable business outcomes: F&O activation, reactivation, ARPAU, revenue impact, funnel conversion, feature adoption, customer engagement and the performance of the growth initiatives you drive.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Experience:** 3–7 years in Product Management, Growth, Business/Product Strategy, Fintech or a similar role
* **F&O exposure:** Hands-on experience with, or strong exposure to, F&O trading products
* **Commercial sense:** A strong understanding of business metrics, revenue levers and growth metrics
* **Growth track record:** Experience working on initiatives involving activation, reactivation, ARPAU, conversion or revenue improvement
* **BRD craft:** Experience creating Business Requirement Documents and translating business problems into clear requirements
* **Product partnership:** Understanding of the product development lifecycle and experience working closely with Product Managers
* **Analytical rigour:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities through data
* **Stakeholder management:** Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across Business, Product and Analytics
* **Ownership:** The ability to work independently and drive business initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurement

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You'll own growth for F&O, one of the most active and revenue-critical segments on one of India's fastest-growing trading platforms.
* Your work is tied directly to outcomes that matter — activation, reactivation, ARPAU and revenue - so your impact is visible and measurable.
* You'll shape what gets built, turning trader insight and data into BRDs that become real product initiatives.
* You'll work alongside sharp Product, Business and Analytics teams who move fast and care about doing it right.
* Every initiative you drive will shape how millions of Indian traders experience the markets.

title: Sr. Product Manager - B2C and Events
description:
**ABOUT US**

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**OUR PEOPLE**

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**OUR IMPACT**

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

The B2C/Creators Product team at HighLevel is focused on building and scaling a world-class learning experience for our customers and their audiences. The platform currently serves over 1.1 million monthly active users, making it one of HighLevel's most widely adopted products. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at scale while solving B2C-style learner experience problems within a B2B2C product ecosystem.

Events is one of the newest products in HighLevel's Memberships suite, currently in beta and being built from the ground up. It gives our customers a native way to create, publish and sell events — in-person, online and hybrid — with ticketing, RSVPs, paid and free registration, and attendee management, sitting directly alongside the contacts, communities, courses, credentials and automations they already run their business on. Organizers build and run their events from the Memberships admin; attendees live the whole thing inside Client Portal, next to the courses, communities and credentials they already sign in for.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own and Shape the B2C & Events Roadmap** Partner with product leadership to help shape and execute the roadmap for HighLevel's B2C platform, serving 1.1M+ monthly active learners, with a focus on engagement, completion, and retention in a B2B2C environment.
* **Close the Table-Stakes Gap, Then Go Past It –** Know the category cold. Get the expected capabilities right — ticket tiers, promo codes, capacity and waitlists, recurring and series events, refunds, embeddable widgets, calendar sync, wallet passes — and then decide deliberately where we go further than the incumbents rather than matching them feature for feature.
* **Take Events from Beta to GA –** Own the beta exit criteria: the quality bar, the reliability bar, the feature completeness, and the adoption and revenue signals that tell us this product is ready to be sold broadly. Drive the program that closes those gaps.
* **Build Ticketing, Checkout and Payments –** Lead paid, free and RSVP event types, multi-tier and multi-currency ticketing, checkout conversion, discounts, taxes, refunds and payouts — with the precision and trust a revenue-bearing flow demands, and with fee and payout terms that are a reason to choose us rather than a reason to resent us.
* **Give Organizers Ownership of Their Audience –** Build the capability that most defines us against the category: every registration flows into the organizer's own CRM, segmentable, automatable and theirs to keep. Turn attendee data ownership from a talking point into the product's most obvious advantage.
* **Own Event-Day Operations –** Events are judged on the day they happen. Own check-in and QR scanning, offline resilience at the door, guest lists and comp tickets, on-site sales, capacity enforcement and the operational tooling organizers depend on when things go wrong in real time.
* **Own the Attendee Experience in Client Portal –** Client Portal is where the attendee side of Events lives, and you own it: how members find what is on, register and check out, hold their tickets, receive reminders and joining links, attend in person or online, and look back at what they have been to. Deliver that journey across both web and mobile, make events feel native to the portal rather than bolted onto it, and hold a phone-first bar throughout.
* **Drive Distribution and Discovery –** Shape how events get found and filled: SEO-ready event pages, social and calendar syndication, embeddable listings, the Gokollab Marketplace, and the promotion tooling that turns an organizer's existing audience into attendance.
* **Open the Platform –** Treat APIs, webhooks and integrations as a first-class surface rather than a premium upsell, so agencies and developers can build events into the workflows and client solutions they already sell.
* **Champion UI/UX Excellence –** Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, mobile-friendly and fast — for both the organizer building an event and the attendee registering for one.
* **Talk to Organizers Constantly –** Run discovery with beta organizers, sit in on their setup, watch where they stall, and turn qualitative signal into a prioritized backlog. At this stage, direct customer contact is a primary input, not a supplement.
* **Experiment and Optimize –** Design and analyze experiments across the funnel — event page conversion, registration completion, checkout drop-off, organizer onboarding — and iterate rapidly on evidence rather than opinion.
* **Support Scale, Reliability and Trust –** Drive the platform work a live-event product demands: registration integrity, capacity and waitlist correctness, payment reliability, fraud and listing trust, and graceful behavior under the traffic spikes that come with a popular event going on sale.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally –** Work across engineering, design, data, support, marketing and customer-facing teams to launch features, drive adoption, and close the loop on organizer feedback.
* **Define and Own the Metrics –** Establish the success metrics for a product that does not yet have them — organizer activation, time to first published event, repeat-event rate, registration and checkout conversion, attendance rate, gross ticket volume and revenue per organizer — set the OKRs against them, and use them to steer the roadmap.
* **Deliver Outcomes, Not Just Features –** Be accountable for measurable growth in events published, organizers activated, registrations processed and ticket revenue running through the platform.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* **B2C Experience –** You have built and shipped impactful features for B2C platforms or content products, creating engaging end user experiences that drive activation, completion, and retention at meaningful scale.
* **An End-to-End Owner –** You are comfortable owning the entire life of an event across two connected surfaces: the creator experience in the Memberships admin, where an organizer builds, prices, publishes, promotes and runs their event, and the attendee experience in Client Portal, where a member discovers it, registers, attends and looks back on it. You think in terms of the whole journey and the handoffs between those surfaces, not in terms of screens.
* **UX-Attentive for Learning –** You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility focused on learner journeys, content discovery, progress tracking, and habit formation, with a track record of delivering intuitive and high-quality learning experiences.
* **Experimentation-Minded –** You are comfortable running A/B tests and structured experiments to improve learner engagement and completion rates through rapid, evidence-based iteration.
* **Learner-Centric –** You consistently balance business objectives with learner success, keeping learner needs, motivation, and outcomes at the center of product decisions.
* **Customer-Obsessed –** You seek out organizers directly, run your own discovery, and can translate what you hear into product decisions without waiting for a research team to formalize it.
* **Strategic and Execution-Focused –** You can contribute meaningfully to product vision while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution to ensure ideas translate into real, measurable impact.
* **Data-Informed –** You rely on behavioral data, funnel metrics, and cohort analysis to prioritize initiatives, validate assumptions, and guide product decisions.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to events, ticketing, marketplace, commerce or B2B2C SaaS products.
* Proven track record of taking a product from early stage to scaled adoption, with clear ownership of the decisions that made it work.
* Hands-on experience with monetization mechanics — checkout, pricing and packaging, payments, refunds, payouts and fee structure — and the operational realities that come with them.
* Working knowledge of the events and ticketing category, including how platforms such as Eventbrite, Luma, Meetup and Cvent are positioned, priced and differentiated.
* Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, with the ability to partner closely with design to deliver intuitive, accessible and high-quality journeys for two distinct user types: organizers and attendees.
* Familiarity with SaaS and B2C platform growth levers, including user activation, engagement loops, retention, lifecycle optimization, and audience monetization.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.
* Bonus: You have worked on an events, ticketing or community platform and can clearly articulate your personal impact on organizer growth, conversion and revenue.

**WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?**

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI
description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.

* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.

* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.

* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.

* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.

* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.

* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.

* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.

* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.

* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.

* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.

* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.

* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.

* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. **About the Company**

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

**Role Summary**

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
* Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.
* Bring member data such as blood diagnostics, CGM readings, symptoms and progress into a clean, usable view that supports faster clinical decisions.
* Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
* Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
* Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
* Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
* Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
* Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

**Requirements (Must-Haves)**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
* Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.
* Experience gathering insight directly from doctors and clinical teams and turning it into shipped product.
* Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
* Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
* Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
* Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
* Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
* Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
* Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

  
**Benefits**  
  
Why Join Elevate Now

* Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
* Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

**Team Overview**

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager who owns technical delivery and application solution outcomes for a major product area or
  
program workstream. This role partners closely with internal business resources and technical teams to analyze requirements and drive the
  
end-to-end design, development or development oversight, testing, implementation, delivery, and documentation of data processing solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will help sequence the roadmap for the next 2–3 Program Increments (PIs), ensure delivery commitments are feasible and well documented, and coordinate across scrum teams to support successful solution design, build, release, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

**Agile & Scrum Leadership**

* Lead delivery of strategic Alternative Credit initiatives, including Alternative Data products, Blended Score capabilities, score
* deployment efforts, data provider integrations, compliance enhancements, platform modernization, and customer onboarding requirements.
* Own technical delivery and application solution execution for a major product area or program workstream; lead delivery across multiple scrum teams so requirements, solution designs, development work, testing, documentation, implementation, and release activities are sequenced, staffed, and ready for iterative delivery.
* Convert business strategy and stakeholder requirements into clear priorities, a sequenced roadmap, and actionable epics and stories; secure alignment across business, architecture, engineering, compliance, and delivery teams before commitment and maintain traceability from outcomes to requirements, user stories, releases, and supporting documentation.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies across product, engineering, analytics, operations, architecture, and support teams so plans are feasible and credible; surface risks early, coordinate mitigations across teams, and remove impediments before they become urgent.
* Escalate the right issues with clear options and trade-offs and drive timely decisions; facilitate prioritization and sequencing based on impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness.
  

**Cross Functional Program Leadership**

* Partner closely with Data Science, Analytics, Product Management, Compliance, and Engineering teams to support the development, implementation, monitoring, and evolution of Alternative and Blended Score products. Coordinate dependencies related to data acquisition, model deployment, score production, validation, operational readiness, and customer adoption.
* Drive roadmap planning and execution for the FactorTrust platform and Alternative Credit ecosystem, balancing technical debt reduction, regulatory requirements, infrastructure modernization, product enhancements, and strategic growth initiatives.
* Partner with internal business resources and technical teams in a matrixed environment—including solutions/product, engineering, architecture, UX, data science/analytics, compliance, legal, product marketing, operations, and support—to analyze requirements, align on outcomes, and coordinate delivery commitments.
* Define and maintain a roadmap for the next 2–3 PIs for your product area/workstream; influence yearly planning and coordinate cross-team sequencing and dependencies.
* Run KPI-driven reviews and adjust the plan to maximize measurable outcomes; use delivery, quality, performance, and operational signals to surface improvement opportunities and drive changes that increase customer value, improve flow, and strengthen solution resiliency.
  

**Product Development Lifecycle Ownership**

* Guide the full product and technical delivery lifecycle—from discovery through launch and iteration—ensuring readiness at each stage, including requirements analysis, solution definition, application design, development oversight, testing, delivery, release, adoption, and documentation.
* Translate customer, business, and stakeholder needs into actionable outcomes and deliverables for multiple teams, accounting for system boundaries, architecture constraints, dependencies, performance considerations, data movement,integrations, and operating model impacts.
* Own and communicate a sequenced roadmap and backlog; continually re-plan based on KPI performance, impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness while tracking medium-term risks and opportunities. Lead discovery workshops, requirements analysis, and technical solution discussions for foundational and high-visibility initiatives; evaluate options and trade-offs, align on approach, and drive end-to-end execution across teams and partner teams.
* Lead requirements definition and technical execution for credit risk products that leverage alternative data, including consumer reporting solutions, score development initiatives, prescreening capabilities, identity and fraud inputs, decisioning integrations, and customer-facing product enhancements.
* Ensure product designs and implementations support regulatory, operational, and customer requirements, including FCRA compliance, model governance standards, audit readiness, data quality controls, and appropriate use of consumer data
  

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

**Technical Expectations**

* A Technical Product Manager owns technical delivery outcomes and understands architecture patterns, application design considerations, data processing concepts, integration points, platform constraints, and application lifecycle practices. This role works directly with engineering to shape, oversee, and deliver sound technical solutions for high-volume, data-driven product platforms.
* Drive application solution ownership for high-volume, data-driven systems and credit risk platforms, including Alternative Data products, FactorTrust capabilities, Blended Scores, and supporting decisioning services by shaping the application design, development approach, testing strategy, implementation plan, operational readiness, and delivery documentation with engineering teams.
* Design or oversee the design and development of data processing solutions, including solution decomposition, application framework considerations, data movement, system integrations, performance, resiliency, debugging, and environment readiness.
* Provide technical direction for Ab Initio-based or similar data processing solutions, including Continuous Flows, application frameworks, performance tuning, debugging, metadata usage, and reusable patterns that can be leveraged by other applications or processes.
* Create and maintain clear documentation that communicates requirements, technical context, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders.
* Identify opportunities to improve tools, processes, services, and system integrations that enable end-user productivity, delivery efficiency, and consistent product execution.
* Collaborate with Data Science and Analytics teams to translate model requirements into scalable production solutions, including score generation workflows, feature engineering requirements, model deployment processes, monitoring frameworks, and performance measurement capabilities.
* Understand credit bureau, alternative data, and blended scoring ecosystems, including data sourcing, consumer reporting requirements, score implementation considerations, model performance monitoring, and client integration patterns.
  

**Leadership Expectations**

* Leads through influence across teams and partner organizations, secures alignment on direction and trade-offs, and operates with sustained
* independence while driving delivery, measurable outcomes, quality documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Influence strategic direction for Alternative Credit and FactorTrust initiatives by aligning business objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, data science priorities, and technology investments into a cohesive delivery roadmap.
  

**Qualifications**

* Typically 8+ years of experience in technical product management, application development, engineering, systems analysis, data processing solution delivery, or related product-focused technical roles, including ownership of a product area or program workstream and leadership across multiple delivery teams.
* Demonstrated experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe delivery environments and driving iterative delivery from requirements through development, testing, release, and post-launch adoption.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate and document technical concepts, requirements, risks, decisions, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with technical teams on application design, data processing solution development, implementation planning, performance considerations, debugging, operational readiness, and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience with data-driven platforms, application ecosystems, cloud services, integration patterns, or related technical environments.
* Experience delivering data-intensive financial products, credit risk solutions, consumer reporting systems, scorecards, predictive models, or alternative data products.
* Knowledge of FCRA, consumer reporting regulations, permissible purpose requirements, and model governance practices
* Experience in the financial services, insurance, and/or banking industry.
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Proven ability to work effectively across complex, matrixed environments.
  

**Preferred:**

* Experience with using multiple different alternative data sources in products
* SAFe PO/PM certification, CSPO or related product management certification
* Experience with cloud services in GCP or AWS
* Experience supporting development, deployment, or operationalization of credit scores, risk models, or machine learning solutions

**Job Description:**

The Retain Cloud Product Owner – Senior Associate is the dedicated product and platform owner for Retain Cloud, the firm’s resource planning and scheduling platform, within the Enterprise Applications Support team. Based in Crowe’s Hyderabad office and working closely with US-based stakeholders, this role combines hands-on administration and configuration with day-to-day product ownership: managing the Retain backlog and roadmap, translating business needs into well-defined epics and user stories, coordinating vendor releases, and driving adoption as additional business units move onto the platform.

This position takes Retain beyond break/fix support. The Product Owner partners with the Retain business owner, business unit resource management teams, the Solutions support team, and the Retain vendor to keep the platform stable, secure, and aligned with firm priorities. As Retain moves into steady-state operations, the role will also be cross-trained on other enterprise applications supported by the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership and Backlog Management:**

  

* Own the Retain Cloud product backlog in ServiceNow, capturing, refining, and prioritizing demands, epics, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Retain business owner and business unit leaders to translate business goals into a product roadmap, release plan, and prioritized backlog.
* Lead requirements gathering and backlog refinement sessions, make day-to-day prioritization decisions, and escalate trade-offs that affect scope, timeline, or investment.
* Confirm that delivered changes meet the intended business need and are ready for release, coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business users.
* Track adoption, data quality, and support trends to measure value and guide priorities.
* Platform Administration and Configuration
* Serve as the primary technical administrator for Retain Cloud, configuring security profiles, skills, scheduling units, booking components, dropdown values, and other system settings.
* Manage user access and role assignments through the ServiceNow access request process, and support periodic access reviews with business approvers.
* Prepare, run, and validate mass booking and other data loads in UAT and production.
* Monitor integrations and daily data feeds, including worker and skills data from Workday, and coordinate the resolution of feed and data issues.
* Maintain configuration documentation and follow the firm’s change management process.
* Release and Vendor Management
* Act as the primary liaison with the Retain vendor: log and track support cases, escalate defects, and monitor vendor SLA performance.
* Review vendor release notes, assess the impact of each Retain Cloud release, and plan and execute regression testing.
* Communicate upcoming releases, resolved issues, and new features to support teams and users, and confirm that incidents addressed in a release are closed afterward.
* Business Unit Onboarding and Adoption
* Lead configuration and readiness work for business units onboarding to Retain Cloud, including requirements, data migration and reconciliation, UAT, and cutover planning.
* oordinate the timing of changes and rollouts with business unit operations leaders to avoid busy season and filing-deadline conflicts.
* Develop training materials and job aids, and help resource managers adopt new features.
* Support and Continuous Improvement
* Serve as the Solutions-level (L3) escalation point for Retain incidents: reproduce issues in the test environment, capture diagnostics, manage problem records, and provide workarounds.
* Build and maintain the Retain knowledge base so Services and Troubleshooting teams can resolve common issues quickly and consistently.
* Analyze ticket trends to find recurring issues and drive permanent fixes or enhancements.
* Support Retain reporting needs by producing accurate scheduling and resource data for resource managers and leadership.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Experience with Workday or other HR system integrations and data loads is a plus.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

* Ability to work during US business hours collaborate with US-based stakeholders, with flexibility for releases, go-lives, and critical escalations.
* Estimate an annual average of 10–15% overtime. Overtime will be required to meet critical deadlines and during busy season months.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for engaging US-based leaders.
* Ability to work independently with broad direction and little supervision while collaborating effectively across a geographically dispersed team.

Tracxn is a leading global market intelligence platform tracking 7.9M + private companies across 3,000+ sectors and 50+ geographies. We turn deep data into decision-ready insights, powering deal sourcing, market mapping, and due diligence for 850+ clients worldwide, including VC firms, Private Equity, Investment Banks, and Corporates.

##### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

As a Senior Associate Product Manager at Tracxn, you’ll support the product team in defining requirements, analyzing performance, and executing product initiatives across the lifecycle. You’ll collaborate with design, engineering, and senior PMs to translate ideas into impactful product features.

This role is ideal for early-career professionals eager to learn product fundamentals, work on a global B2B SaaS platform, and grow into a full-fledged Product Manager.

##### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Feature Specification:** Assist Product Managers in defining feature specifications and writing detailed product requirement documents (PRDs).
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with design, engineering, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution across the product lifecycle.
* **Performance Analysis:** Review and analyze key product metrics to track performance and identify improvement areas.
* **Design Support:** Collaborate with the UX team to create wireframes, mockups, and design documentation.
* **Data & Insights:** Use data and API tools (like Postman) to extract insights and validate product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Documentation Management:** Maintain reports, knowledge repositories, and other operational resources for effective tracking and learning.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify workflow bottlenecks and suggest enhancements to improve efficiency and product quality.

##### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **1–3 years of work experience who have graduated from a Tier 1 college.**
* An engineering background is a must.
* Strong interest in B2B SaaS products and technology, with empathy for users and a problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to structure and analyze ambiguous problems effectively.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly convey ideas through workflows, feature descriptions, and documentation.
* A long-term desire to build a career in Product Management and grow into a full-fledged PM role.
* Preferred: prior exposure to SQL, Postman, or other data/API tools.
* Preferred: internship or project experience in product management, UX, or a related field.

##### **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT TRACXN**

* Fixed work timings — 9 hrs × 5 days. Respect for personal time; no taking work home.
* A transparent, meritocratic culture where everyone explains the “why” behind their decisions.
* A candid and collaborative environment that values learning, curiosity, and open discussions.
* Managers and mentors who invest in your growth with timely, actionable feedback.
* Continuous learning through real-time projects and cross-functional exposure.
